tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search the model register: open-weight AI model releases with exact parameter counts, architectural context length, licence and release date. Use this to answer questions about which models exist, how big they are, what they are licensed under, or what shipped recently.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Get the full record for one model, including every field and the endpoint each field was sourced from. Use when you need provenance or complete detail.

tools.name: recent_releases
tools.description: Models first recorded in the register within the last N days. Use to answer 'what shipped recently' or 'what is new in open-weight models'.

tools.name: register_stats
tools.description: Summary of what the register covers: how many models, field coverage, organisations tracked, and the inclusion rule. Use to judge whether the register can answer a question before querying it.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search stories published by The Neural Net. Each story is written from a primary source and links to it. Use for narrative context on a release rather than raw model facts.

tools.name: get_wire
tools.description: Everything The Neural Net harvested in the last day that it did not write up, grouped by source and linked to the original. Use for a broad view of current activity.
